items.corrections: CryptOracle is a performance-characterization framework, not an FHE scheme achieving polylogarithmic slowdown. The exact algorithmic and hardware claim remains unsupported.
Official RFC documents concrete post-quantum standards and larger-size tradeoffs. Standardization is bounded progress; comparable ECC/RSA sizes and migration without penalties remain unsupported.
The opened obfuscation paper proves conditional consequences and discusses assumptions; it does not provide the claimed general-purpose secure construction. The claimed broader impact is unsupported.
Author-hosted abstract reports a three-group-element preprocessing SNARK with three pairings. Trusted-setup-free requirement and massive-scale impact are not established.

The opened MPC paper establishes bounded VSS results and impossibility boundaries, not constant communication overhead for general information-theoretic MPC. The claimed broader impact is unsupported.

NIST standard establishes hash-based post-quantum signatures, but provides no evidence for the assigned <100-byte/microsecond conjunction; RFC table lists substantially larger standardized alternatives.

Primary abstract presents an everlasting UC commitment under physical token assumptions and hardness during execution. This is not unconditional arbitrary data protection against every future adversary.

Primary abstract reports general-purpose verified-computation construction/prototype and specialized streaming advances. Minimal overhead for every computation and claimed post-quantum properties are not established.
No opened source established a new quantum-resistant hardness assumption enabling iO or other advanced primitives. The claimed broader impact is unsupported.
No opened source established fundamental information-theoretic limits for cryptographic primitives generally in the quantum era. The claimed broader impact is unsupported.

notes: All nine originally retrieved positive/background URLs reopened and actual topics/passages matched.
No URL/title mismatches found. Narrowed FHE profiling and signature-standard claims; removed unverified everyday-use wording.
Theoretical and preprint results remain author claims, not independent mathematical validation.
